dp[0] = 0
For each mask, let i = lowest bit not in mask
For each j > i not in mask:
    if A[i] + A[j] is power of 2:
        dp[mask | (1<<i) | (1<<j)] = max(..., dp[mask] + 1)

import sys
from collections import defaultdict

def solve():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    N = int(input_data[0])
    A = list(map(int, input_data[1:N+1]))
    # Use networkx for general matching
    import networkx as nx
    G = nx.Graph()
    G.add_nodes_from(range(N))
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(i+1, N):
            s = A[i] + A[j]
            if s & (s-1) == 0:
                G.add_edge(i, j)
    matching = nx.max_weight_matching(G, maxcardinality=True)
    print(len(matching))

solve()
